aboutSubheading: Trusted local builders with a commitment to excellence
aboutText: Patterson Homes has been delivering exceptional residential construction across Melbourne's south-east and the Mornington Peninsula for over 15 years. Based on Nepean Highway in Carrum, we specialise in custom homes, duplexes, and multi-unit developments that stand the test of time. Our team takes pride in honest communication, quality craftsmanship, and results that speak for themselves.

servicesSubheading: Comprehensive building solutions for every project
servicesText: From custom homes to multi-unit developments, Patterson Homes offers a full range of building services tailored to your needs. Every project is managed with the same dedication to quality, transparency, and on-time delivery.

services.title: Custom Home Building
services.desc: From initial design to handover, we build your dream home with premium materials and meticulous attention to detail across Melbourne's south-east.

services.title: Duplex Construction
services.desc: Maximise your property's potential with our expertly designed and built duplex developments, delivering value and quality in every square metre.

services.title: Multi-Unit Development
services.desc: Comprehensive multi-unit development services for investors and developers, from planning and permits through to final handover.

services.title: Townhouse Construction
services.desc: Modern, stylish townhouse builds that blend functionality with contemporary design, perfect for infill sites across Carrum and surrounds.

services.title: Show Home Showcasing
services.desc: Experience our craftsmanship firsthand at our beautifully appointed show homes, showcasing the latest in design, finishes, and sustainable building.

services.title: Renovations & Extensions
services.desc: Transform your existing home with quality renovations and extensions that add space, value, and modern appeal while respecting your budget.

testimonialsSubheading: Real feedback from homeowners and developers across Melbourne's south-east

testimonials.text: Patterson Homes built our family home in Carrum and the entire process was seamless. Dan and his team communicated every step of the way, and the quality of workmanship exceeded our expectations. Couldn't recommend them more highly.
testimonials.name: Marcus Thornton

testimonials.text: We engaged Patterson Homes for a duplex development in Seaford and couldn't be happier with the result. They delivered on time, on budget, and the finishes are absolutely top-notch. Will definitely be using them again for our next project.
testimonials.name: Sarah Mitchell

testimonials.text: As a repeat client, I've trusted Patterson Homes with three townhouse projects now. Their professionalism and build quality are second to none in the Bayside area. Every project has been a smooth experience from start to finish.
testimonials.name: James Calloway
